intent: Loop: resumable bounded wait (gator loop wait --max-seconds, exit 3 = reissue) (#36)
notes: `loop/cli.py`: `gator loop wait` gains optional `--max-seconds` (validated positive finite via `_positive_seconds`). Bounded wait returns exit 3 (`WAIT_EXIT_STILL_WAITING`, `wake_reason: "still_waiting"`) and prints the exact reissue command when the deadline passes while another role owns the turn. Monotonic deadline; each sleep capped at the remaining time; session re-read after the final sleep so a turn change at the deadline still wins. Omitted flag keeps the unbounded behavior. Exit 0/2 meanings unchanged; wait stays read-only.
JSON output stays `gator-loop-status-v1`, adding `max_seconds`, `waited_seconds`, `reissue_command` (null when unbounded / not still waiting).

Participant protocol (`.includes` + byte-identical starter copy), `/loop-join` template + live `.claude/commands/` copy, `gatorize/entry_points.py` renderer, and live CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md managed blocks now teach `gator loop wait --token <token> --max-seconds 45` with the exit 0 / 3 / 2 handling (reissue on 3; a returned wait does not end participation).

Tests: new `TestBoundedWait` (fake clock/sleep — already actionable, wake before deadline, turn change at deadline, still_waiting without overrun or writes, pause/terminal preempt, invalid `--max-seconds` via type/parser/_cmd_wait, text + JSON exit-3 output, unbounded JSON nulls); `TestWaitHandoffAlignment` pins the bounded command + reissue guidance on every participant surface and the live `/loop-join` copy identity.
Charters: `scripts-loop.md` adds `_cmd_wait` and `_wait_for_actionable` entries (previously uncharted); `scripts-installer.md` and `scripts-cross-cutting.md` updated for the bounded handoff contract.
